name: React Summit Amsterdam 2025
description:
**Join us at the biggest React conference on June 13 & 17, 2025 in Amsterdam & Online!** 

[React Summit](https://reactsummit.com/) — the annual conference dedicated to all things React, bringing together thousands of Front-end and Full-stack engineers from around the globe.

**🚨 Important! To secure your spot, make sure to get your ticket through this [LINK](https://reactsummit.com/).**

🎙 **Call for Proposals**
Are you ready to speak in front of the world’s largest React audience? Submit your talk proposal via our [CFP form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf3hJVEYAj1auSk3lWCke-JSsJbiD0DdKTgQYWHsReadPQAyQ/viewform) and take the stage at the upcoming conference!

**What to expect at the conference:**

🌍 New Venue: Circa Amsterdam – a creative and sustainable space.
🗣️ 60+ React Experts: Hear from top OSS contributors and industry rising stars.
🏆 React OSS Awards: Celebrating open-source achievements and collaboration.
🚤 Amsterdam Vibes: Connect with fellow developers while exploring the city by boat or on foot.
🎉 React’s Biggest Party: Enjoy a festival atmosphere with activities, music, and more!

This year we expect the authors and core teams of **Next.js, React 19, React Compiler, Cursor, TypeScript, Tanstack Start, Zustand, React Server Components, Tailwind, Remix & more.**

Don’t miss out on this celebration of React!

👉  Follow us on social media: [Bluesky,](https://bsky.app/profile/reactsummit.gitnation.org) [Twitter (X)](https://twitter.com/reactsummit), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/reactsummit/), [Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/reactsummit), [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/reactsummit/)
